description: CKEditor 5 integration for ASP.NET Core Blazor Server and WebAssembly. Supports Classic, Inline, Decoupled and Multiroot editor types, live two-way data binding, file and image upload, shared context for collaborative features, custom TypeScript plugins, full localization, self-hosted assets via MSBuild, CDN loading with import maps, reusable configuration presets, and built-in watchdog for automatic crash recovery.
